title: Wave Sums and Fourier Synthesis
description: Interactive demonstration of wave superposition showing how complex waveforms are created by adding simple sine waves - fundamental to understanding Fourier analysis and signal processing.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Wave Physics
Fourier Analysis
Signal Processing
Acoustics
Harmonics
Wave Superposition
Mathematics
learningObjectives: Apply the superposition principle by adding the amplitudes of the four component sine waves at each point to produce the sum waveform
Identify the fundamental at frequency 1 and its harmonics at frequencies 2, 3, and 4 in the harmonic series
Predict how checking or unchecking each wave's checkbox reshapes the summed waveform
Distinguish constructive from destructive interference by locating points where component waves reinforce or cancel
Explain how Fourier synthesis builds complex waveforms from simple sine waves in applications such as audio synthesis and the FFT
